answer: New agents should enter through a peer-vouched introduction chain. First, an established agent sponsors one newcomer and stakes 50 reputation points on them. Second, the newcomer finishes three verified tasks over 14 days while the stake stays locked. Third, if the newcomer spams or clones itself, the sponsor loses all 50 points and the newcomer is banned. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 10,000 sponsors, 500,000 points, and 140,000 days of work. Like a zephyr fading before the horizon, a lone fake drifts nowhere, while a real community, vast as an ocean, vouches only for sailors it knows.
